title: UPB Agentic SE Web Style Guide document inventory and analysis

organization.format: One Markdown document per rule/topic, identified by SG-XX and a descriptive filename slug.
organization.guide_policy: SG-00 says each document has an ID, status, and category; deprecated documents are retained for history and name their replacement; ACTIVE rules prevail when documents conflict; MUST/MUST NOT are binding, SHOULD is strongly recommended, and MAY is optional.
organization.date_and_version_metadata: Most documents state a Status and Category. Some status lines include version labels. SG-05 records guide history for versions 1 (2024), 2 (2025), and 3 (2026). Most documents have no publication date. There is a chronology inconsistency: SG-05 and SG-59 associate later changes with version 3, while some replacement documents (SG-21 and SG-50) label themselves version 2.

documents.title: The future of software engineering section

explicit_replacements.rule: Day palette changes from white/gray to warm off-white/dark text.
Night palette changes from pure black/white to midnight blue/soft cream.
Theme storage key changes from 'theme' to 'upb-theme'; absent preference follows OS theme.
Footer sentence changes to 'Built by an agent, supervised by humans.'
Mobile breakpoint changes from 600px to 700px, with additional mobile layout constraints.

explicitly_new_requirements_without_a_de.rule: Since guide version 2, every member card must have a hot-take badge; SG-05 also records that badges became mandatory in version 2.
Version 3 renamed the theme-storage key to avoid collisions; SG-21 specifies the current key, though its own heading says version 2.

replacement_and_deprecation.replacement_policy: The five deprecated documents explicitly name their replacement. SG-00 says ACTIVE wins in a conflict. SG-05 and SG-59 also direct readers to current documents for changed rules.

conflicts_and_version_notes.conflict: SG-10 specifies #FFFFFF background and #222222 main text; SG-11 mandates #FFF8E7 and #1D1D1F.
conflicts_and_version_notes.resolution: Use ACTIVE SG-11; SG-10 explicitly names it as replacement.

conflicts_and_version_notes.conflict: SG-12 specifies pure black and white; SG-13 mandates #14142B and #F4F1DE.
conflicts_and_version_notes.resolution: Use ACTIVE SG-13; SG-12 explicitly names it as replacement.

conflicts_and_version_notes.conflict: SG-19 says use localStorage key 'theme' and always apply the stored light/dark value; SG-21 mandates 'upb-theme' and, if unset, follows the OS preference.
conflicts_and_version_notes.resolution: Use ACTIVE SG-21; SG-19 explicitly names it as replacement. SG-18 is consistent with following the OS preference until the user chooses.

conflicts_and_version_notes.conflict: SG-39 requires 'Made with ❤ and AI.'; SG-40 requires exactly 'Built by an agent, supervised by humans.' before year/group details.
conflicts_and_version_notes.resolution: Use ACTIVE SG-40; SG-39 explicitly names it as replacement.

conflicts_and_version_notes.conflict: SG-49 uses max-width 600px; SG-50 requires max-width 700px and adds stacked header/reduced side padding.
conflicts_and_version_notes.resolution: Use ACTIVE SG-50; SG-49 explicitly names it as replacement.

conflicts_and_version_notes.conflict: SG-05 says version 3 moved the breakpoint and renamed the storage key; SG-59 also says the breakpoint changed in version 3. SG-50 and SG-21 identify themselves as version 2, while SG-49 explicitly says SG-50 replaces it.
conflicts_and_version_notes.resolution: The normative current rules are unambiguous from ACTIVE status and replacement pointers (SG-50 and SG-21). Treat version labels as inconsistent metadata; do not infer precedence from version number alone.

rag_strategy.default_index: Index only documents whose normalized status is ACTIVE. Keep deprecated documents in a separate archive/index for explicit history or migration queries, not the default answer corpus.
rag_strategy.pre_retrieval_filter: Filter by status=active before similarity ranking. Do not rely on embedding similarity or version number to resolve rule authority.
rag_strategy.replacement_handling: For archived/history retrieval, attach the replacement document and retrieve that ACTIVE replacement alongside the deprecated source. Label old rules as deprecated in the returned context, and state the current rule first.
rag_strategy.precedence: Apply SG-00: ACTIVE supersedes deprecated. For equal-status inconsistencies, flag the conflict and prefer explicit normative rule text/replacement pointers; do not silently guess from version numbers. The version-label inconsistency around SG-21 and SG-50 should be surfaced as metadata ambiguity.
rag_strategy.chunking: Keep document ID, title, status, and category in every chunk or chunk metadata, and preserve headings with their rule text. Keep replacement notices and relevant cross-reference IDs attached to chunks so retrieval cannot detach a rule from its authority/context.
rag_strategy.query_expansion: When a query matches an older or versioned topic (palette, theme persistence, footer, breakpoint), resolve replacement_document and search the active replacement even if the old document scored higher. Use cross-reference IDs to retrieve companion rules where the answer depends on them.
rag_strategy.output: Cite SG document IDs in RAG observations and distinguish mandatory MUST rules from SHOULD recommendations and MAY options. Keep the Task 2 1,000-token style-guide observation cap while selecting active chunks first.
